The Initiative

Back to School, Back to Dignity.

STRIDE 2026 is Pad Up Foundation's flagship back-to-school campaign. We're mobilizing resources to reach 1,000 students in Rivers State before the new academic year begins — delivering backpacks, writing materials, sanitary pads, and educational support directly to the communities that need them most.

For many families, the cost of school essentials is a barrier that keeps children, especially girls, from returning to class. STRIDE removes that barrier.

The Challenge

Why STRIDE Matters

Every new school year, families in underserved communities face an impossible choice: buy school essentials or meet basic needs. Girls carry an additional burden.

School Essentials Are Out of Reach

Many parents cannot afford backpacks, exercise books, and writing materials. Children show up empty-handed or don't show up at all.

Periods Keep Girls Out of Class

Without sanitary pads, girls miss school during their menstrual cycle. Missing a few days each month adds up to weeks of lost learning every term.

Education Is the Way Out

Every child equipped for school is a child with a chance at a better future. STRIDE ensures no student is left behind because of poverty.
